connectors.name: AIVane
connectors.description: Lists saved AIVane browser and desktop automations, runs them with new inputs in the cloud or on a local Windows computer with the AIVane desktop app, and checks, lists and stops runs, asking before starting or stopping a run.
connectors.use_case: Running a saved invoice download automation for October, stopping a stuck scraping run.

connectors.name: Android-MCP
connectors.description: Controls an Android device connected and authorized over ADB, capturing UI snapshots and clicking, long-clicking, swiping, dragging, typing and pressing keys for app navigation, UI interaction and automated QA testing.
connectors.use_case: Navigating through an Android app to test a flow, running an automated QA pass on a connected device.

connectors.name: api.agi.tech
connectors.description: Gives an agent tap-and-type control of an Android phone's screen, working across any installed app without per-app integrations.
connectors.use_case: Running a recurring task in a phone app overnight, testing an Android build across screen sizes, driving an app that exposes no API.

connectors.name: Brave (AppleScript)
connectors.description: Controls Brave Browser tabs, windows, and navigation and reads page content through Brave's AppleScript API.
connectors.use_case: Opening a set of reference pages for a task, pulling the text of the current page into notes, closing tabs left from an earlier session.

connectors.name: Control Chrome
connectors.description: Opens URLs in Google Chrome, lists, switches, reloads and closes tabs, moves back and forward, reads page content and runs JavaScript in a tab, through Chrome's AppleScript API.
connectors.use_case: Reading the text of the page open in Chrome, closing stray tabs, running a JavaScript snippet on a page.

connectors.name: Control your Mac
connectors.description: Runs AppleScript commands on macOS to control applications, change system settings and automate other tasks on the Mac.
connectors.use_case: Changing a system setting from a chat, scripting an application to repeat a routine task.

connectors.name: Dash
connectors.description: Lists installed Dash docsets, searches documentation and code snippets across them, loads full documentation pages and turns on full-text search for chosen docsets, from the macOS documentation browser.
connectors.use_case: Quick API reference lookups from the Dash documentation browser on macOS.

connectors.name: Desktop Commander
connectors.description: Reads, writes, edits, moves and searches local files and directories, writes PDFs, starts terminal processes, interacts with them and reads their output, and lists and kills running processes.
connectors.use_case: Searching a repository's files and editing a block of code, starting a server and reading its output, organizing project files into folders.

connectors.name: Desktop steward
connectors.description: Lists, searches, reads, writes, moves, renames, zips and deletes files in chosen folders on a Mac or Windows computer, finds duplicate photos, shows disk usage, follows folder rules, confirms before risky steps and undoes changes.
connectors.use_case: Sorting 300 downloads into folders by type, finding duplicate holiday photos, undoing a mistaken move.

connectors.name: e2llm
connectors.description: Connects Claude to a real browser through an extension, reading pages as structured representations and acting through per-action permission grants.
connectors.use_case: Reading a dashboard behind a login and summarizing it, filling a form on a site already signed into, clicking through a multi-step flow in an open tab.

connectors.name: Firefox Control
connectors.description: Manages Firefox tabs, searches browsing history, and reads page text through a paired add-on with per-domain consent.
connectors.use_case: Closing duplicate tabs, finding a page visited last week, summarizing an open article.

connectors.name: MacOS-MCP
connectors.description: Launches apps, manages windows, clicks, types, scrolls and sends keyboard shortcuts through the macOS Accessibility API, captures desktop state, automates browsers, runs shell commands and posts notifications, on macOS 12 or higher.
connectors.use_case: Launching an app and arranging its windows, clicking through and typing into a desktop app's interface, running a shell command and capturing the desktop state.

connectors.name: Read and Send iMessages
connectors.description: Reads recent and unread messages in the macOS Messages app, searches contacts and sends iMessages, once access to Messages and Contacts is granted through macOS security prompts.
connectors.use_case: Summarizing unread messages, finding a contact and sending a quick reply.

connectors.name: Remote Desktop Commander
connectors.description: Hosted MCP server that gives an AI client filesystem and terminal access to a paired computer over OAuth from anywhere.
connectors.use_case: Read a file on your home desktop and run a terminal command on it from your phone.

connectors.name: Rooster Wake
connectors.description: Wakes registered computers through an always-on device on the same network, reports their power state, holds them awake on paid plans, sleeps them after asking first, and starts Claude Code sessions in registered folders on Windows.
connectors.use_case: Waking a dev machine from a phone, holding it awake through a long build, starting a coding session in a registered folder.

connectors.name: Still Dock
connectors.description: Checks which Mac Dock locks are active and turns locks on or off for Dock size, position, hide and show behavior, contents, display setting and Cmd Q on connected Macs.
connectors.use_case: Locking the Dock after rearranging apps, unlocking the Dock position to move it to the left edge, checking which locks are on before a presentation.

connectors.name: Vybit Notifications
connectors.description: Creates, updates and deletes Vybit notification endpoints, triggers push notifications with custom sounds, browses and subscribes to public vybits, manages access permissions and reminders, and reads notification logs and API usage.
connectors.use_case: Creating a vybit with a custom sound and triggering it, subscribing to a public vybit, checking which notifications went out in the logs.

connectors.name: Windows-MCP
connectors.description: Controls a Windows computer by opening and managing apps and windows, clicking, typing, scrolling and sending shortcuts, capturing screenshots and UI state, running PowerShell commands, and working with files, the clipboard, processes, notifications and the registry.
connectors.use_case: Testing an app's UI by clicking through it, moving files between folders, running a PowerShell command.
